title: Parking License Product Sheet — Space Type, Cover and Gate Access
content:
The six Parking License products differ in whether a numbered space is assigned, whether the space is covered, whether garage gate access comes with the license, and how many gate remotes are issued without charge when the license starts.

| Parking product | Numbered space assigned | Covered space | Gate access issued with the license | Gate remotes issued without charge at start |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | No | No | No | 0 |
| Surface Reserved Space | Yes | No | No | 0 |
| Covered Carport Space | Yes | Yes | No | 0 |
| Structured Garage Space | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Private Detached Garage | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 |

## Points of comparison

- A **Surface Unreserved Permit** is the only product without a numbered space.
- **Covered** space starts at the Covered Carport Space; the two surface products are uncovered.
- **Gate access** comes only with the Structured Garage Space, the EV Charging Reserved Space and the Private Detached Garage. The first two issue one remote at start; the Private Detached Garage issues two.
- Products without gate access issue no remotes (0).
